strongest_angle: Clear communication remains critical in AI‑mediated workplaces, and Purdue research shows it directly boosts trust and cuts costly errors.

key_facts.fact: A Purdue University study of 1,200 professionals found that clear communication increased trust in AI‑mediated collaborations by 27 % compared with ambiguous messaging.
The same Purdue research reported that teams with strong communication skills experienced 34 % fewer operational errors when using AI decision‑support tools.
Purdue’s Daniels School of Business surveyed 850 managers and concluded that 78 % view communication competence as the most important non‑technical skill for future AI‑rich roles.
